description: This file is a React component for the Notesnook project, specifically a step in a process to paste and parse encrypted sync data, including instructions for capturing raw encrypted data from browser developer tools, and handling the parsing of JSON messages containing encrypted notes, content, notebooks, and attachments.

classes.name: PasteEncryptedDataProps
classes.description: Props for the PasteEncryptedData React component, including callback for when encrypted data is pasted.

classes.name: EncryptedSyncItem
classes.description: Type representing an encrypted item used in sync data, including algorithm, cipher, format, id, iv, length, salt, and version.

classes.name: SyncRequestBody
classes.description: Type representing the structure of the sync request body, containing arrays of encrypted notes, content, notebooks, and attachments.
